phase_1_ingestion_and_simulation.action: Generate synthetic dataset when actual logs are oversized or restricted.
phase_1_ingestion_and_simulation.implementation: Use uniform, normal, and categorical random samples maintaining coordinate and demographic bounds.

phase_2_preprocessing.implementation: Calculate straight-line/routed distances, compute duration derivatives (speed, pace), and transform demographic timestamps into numeric metrics.

phase_3_aggregation_and_filtering.action: Exclude structural noise and target edge cases.
phase_3_aggregation_and_filtering.implementation: Remove zero/negative values, filter unreasonable durations, and discard uninformative categories.

phase_4_visualization_and_insights.action: Expose spatial patterns and cross-demographic trends.
phase_4_visualization_and_insights.implementation: Deploy binning for spatial density, segmented line graphs for trends, and stacked columns for demography.
